findings.title: Content Security Policy is missing
findings.evidence: The root response does not include Content-Security-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Define a restrictive Content-Security-Policy, starting with default-src 'self', and allow only required sources.

findings.title: MIME-sniffing protection is missing
findings.evidence: The root response does not include X-Content-Type-Options.

findings.title: Clickjacking protection is missing
findings.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor a CSP frame-ancestors directive was observed.
findings.recommendation: Set an appropriate Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors directive; X-Frame-Options may be used for legacy clients.

findings.title: Referrer Policy is missing
findings.evidence: The root response does not include Referrer-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Set Referrer-Policy to a deliberate value such as strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

findings.title: Permissions Policy is missing
findings.evidence: The root response does not include Permissions-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Disable browser features the application does not use with Permissions-Policy.

findings.title: Server software banner is exposed
findings.recommendation: Remove or generalize the Server header where practical; keep software patched.

findings.title: Technology stack banner exposed via X-Powered-By
findings.recommendation: Disable or suppress the X-Powered-By header in web application configuration to prevent framework profiling.

findings.title: Cookie lab_session has missing security attributes
findings.evidence: Set-Cookie for lab_session is missing: HttpOnly, SameSite.
findings.recommendation: Set Secure on HTTPS cookies, HttpOnly unless JavaScript access is required, and an appropriate SameSite value.

findings.title: Application is served over unencrypted HTTP
findings.evidence: The target origin uses HTTP rather than HTTPS.
findings.recommendation: Use HTTPS for applications handling accounts, sessions, or sensitive data; redirect HTTP to HTTPS in production.

findings.title: Cleartext password authentication form over unencrypted HTTP
findings.evidence: A password input field was detected on an unencrypted HTTP page at /.
findings.recommendation: Enforce HTTPS across all authentication pages to prevent credentials from being intercepted on the network.

findings.title: Dangerous HTTP TRACE method enabled (Cross-Site Tracing risk)
findings.evidence: OPTIONS / advertised TRACE in Allow header: GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, TRACE.
findings.recommendation: Disable the HTTP TRACE method on the web server to prevent Cross-Site Tracing (XST) attacks that steal session cookies.

findings.title: Directory listing may be exposed at /uploads/
findings.evidence: GET /uploads/ returned HTTP 200 with directory-listing content.
findings.recommendation: Disable directory indexing and ensure private files are outside the web root or protected by access controls.

findings.title: Exposed environment configuration file (/.env)
findings.evidence:
GET /.env returned HTTP 200 containing application configuration secrets: APP_ENV=local
APP_KEY=base64:demo_test_secret_key_12345
DB_CONNECTION=mysql
DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
DB_DATABASE=lab_db
DB_USER...
findings.recommendation: Block public web-server access to .env files and relocate sensitive secrets outside the web root.

findings.title: Exposed Git repository metadata (/.git/HEAD)
findings.evidence: GET /.git/HEAD returned HTTP 200 revealing repository branch metadata: ref: refs/heads/main.
findings.recommendation: Configure the web server to block requests to .git directories and version-control metadata files.

findings.title: Information disclosure in robots.txt
findings.evidence:
GET /robots.txt returned HTTP 200 advertising path restrictions: User-agent: *
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /backup/...
findings.recommendation: Review robots.txt entries to ensure administrative or private application endpoints are secured with authentication.
